step1_analysis.circuit_type: Voltage-Controlled Ring Oscillator Tuning Block / Varactor Array
step1_analysis.description: This circuit acts as a frequency tuning block for a multiple-pass ring oscillator. It uses PMOS and NMOS transistors configured as MOS varactors and variable resistive loads, whose effective capacitance and resistance are modulated by the control voltage (VCONTROL) to tune the oscillation frequency.

paper_reference.title: A 5.9-GHz Voltage-Controlled Ring Oscillator in 0.18-um CMOS

operating_frequency.description: Center oscillation frequency at nominal control voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Based on a 3-stage ring oscillator with ~30ps delay per stage, driven by the varactor loads.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The added capacitance from the 5um/0.5um varactors (~25fF per node) combined with the testbench RC delay will yield an oscillation frequency in the 5 GHz range, matching the paper's target.

tuning_range.description: Difference between maximum and minimum oscillation frequency across the VCONTROL range.

sky130_expected.calculation: Frequency at VCONTROL=0V minus frequency at VCONTROL=1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The varactor capacitance changes significantly across the 1.8V tuning range, providing a wide frequency tuning range.

power_consumption.description: Total power dissipation of the tuning block.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The varactors draw minimal DC current, but AC switching and the resistive loads (XM7/XM8) will consume a few milliwatts.

phase_noise.description: Phase noise at 1 MHz offset from the carrier.

sky130_expected.calculation: Estimated based on typical ring oscillator performance in 130nm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Phase noise is heavily dependent on the oscillator topology and Q-factor. A 3-stage ring in sky130 typically achieves around 100 dBc/Hz at 1MHz offset.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench that embeds the tuning block DUT into an ideal 3-stage ring oscillator to measure center frequency, tuning range, and power consumption.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VCO Tuning Block Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

XM1 VCONTROL S_MINUS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VCONTROL OUT_PLUS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VCONTROL S_PLUS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VCONTROL OUT_MINUS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VCONTROL P_PLUS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 VCONTROL P_MINUS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM8 OUT_PLUS N1 VCONTROL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM7 OUT_MINUS N1 VCONTROL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVCONTROL VCONTROL 0 0.9
VN1 N1 0 0.9

* Ideal 3-stage Ring Oscillator to drive the DUT
B1 N1_P_int 0 V='1.8 * (0.5 - 0.5*tanh(10*(v(S_PLUS)-0.9)))'
R1 N1_P_int P_PLUS 500
C1 P_PLUS 0 10f
B2 N1_N_int 0 V='1.8 * (0.5 - 0.5*tanh(10*(v(S_MINUS)-0.9)))'
R2 N1_N_int P_MINUS 500
C2 P_MINUS 0 10f

B3 N2_P_int 0 V='1.8 * (0.5 - 0.5*tanh(10*(v(P_PLUS)-0.9)))'
R3 N2_P_int OUT_PLUS 500
C3 OUT_PLUS 0 10f
B4 N2_N_int 0 V='1.8 * (0.5 - 0.5*tanh(10*(v(P_MINUS)-0.9)))'
R4 N2_N_int OUT_MINUS 500
C4 OUT_MINUS 0 10f

B5 N3_P_int 0 V='1.8 * (0.5 - 0.5*tanh(10*(v(OUT_PLUS)-0.9)))'
R5 N3_P_int S_PLUS 500
C5 S_PLUS 0 10f
B6 N3_N_int 0 V='1.8 * (0.5 - 0.5*tanh(10*(v(OUT_MINUS)-0.9)))'
R6 N3_N_int S_MINUS 500
C6 S_MINUS 0 10f

.ic v(P_PLUS)=1.8 v(P_MINUS)=0 v(OUT_PLUS)=0 v(OUT_MINUS)=1.8 v(S_PLUS)=1.8 v(S_MINUS)=0

.control
  * Measure Center Frequency
  tran 1p 10n uic
  meas tran t1 trig v(OUT_PLUS) val=0.9 rise=20 targ v(OUT_PLUS) val=0.9 rise=21
  let freq_center = 1 / t1
  print freq_center
  
  meas tran v_max max v(OUT_PLUS) from=5n to=10n
  meas tran v_min min v(OUT_PLUS) from=5n to=10n
  let v_swing = v_max - v_min
  print v_swing
  
  meas tran i_vdd avg i(VVDD) from=5n to=10n
  let power_mw = -i_vdd * 1.8 * 1000
  print power_mw

  * Measure Min Frequency (VCONTROL = 0.0V)
  alter VVCONTROL 0.0
  tran 1p 10n uic
  meas tran t_min trig v(OUT_PLUS) val=0.9 rise=20 targ v(OUT_PLUS) val=0.9 rise=21
  let freq_min = 1 / t_min
  print freq_min

  * Measure Max Frequency (VCONTROL = 1.8V)
  alter VVCONTROL 1.8
  tran 1p 10n uic
  meas tran t_max trig v(OUT_PLUS) val=0.9 rise=20 targ v(OUT_PLUS) val=0.9 rise=21
  let freq_max = 1 / t_max
  print freq_max

  quit
.endc
